meta.title: GUNDAM 0083 HARNESS
meta.description: The U.C.0083 Dendrobium panoramic cockpit: hangar doors open onto a starfield that snaps into speed lines, the EFSF emblem lights up and seven system checks draw themselves in sequence; after camera calibration the canopy seals over fading A-pillars, a three-section MFD deck, periodic sweeps and pointer parallax, with a cold dark theme.
